channel.title: Data Skeptic
channel.itunes:summary: The Data Skeptic Podcast features interviews and discussion of topics related to data science, statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence and the like, all from the perspective of applying critical thinking and the scientific method to evaluate the veracity of claims and efficacy of approaches.

item.title: Charts You Can Navigate by Ear
item.itunes:title: Charts You Can Navigate by Ear
item.description: Kyle speaks with Jonathan Zong about making data visualizations accessible to blind and low-vision users through screen readers, interactive tools like Olli, and inclusive design approaches that enable independent data exploration.

item.title: Working in Extended Reality
item.itunes:title: Working in Extended Reality
item.description: Doug Bowman, Professor of Computer Science at Virginia Tech, joins Kyle to explore how augmented reality, virtual reality, and AI are reshaping the future of human-computer interaction. From wearable virtual workspaces to intelligent interfaces that adapt to our surroundings, they discuss the opportunities, challenges, and privacy concerns of a world where computing extends beyond the screen.
